064/**
065 * <p>Manages {@link DefaultUserProfile} objects using XML files for persistence. Passwords are hashed using SHA1. User entries are simple
066 * <code>&lt;user&gt;</code> elements under the root. User profile properties are attributes of the element. For example:</p>
067 * <blockquote><code>
068 * &lt;users&gt;<br/>
069 * &nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;user loginName="janne" fullName="Janne Jalkanen"<br/>
070 * &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;wikiName="JanneJalkanen" email="janne@ecyrd.com"<br/>
071 * &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;password="{SHA}457b08e825da547c3b77fbc1ff906a1d00a7daee"/&gt;<br/>
072 * &lt;/users&gt;
073 * </code></blockquote>
074 * <p>In this example, the un-hashed password is <code>myP@5sw0rd</code>. Passwords are hashed without salt.</p>
075 * @since 2.3
076 */
077
078// FIXME: If the DB is shared across multiple systems, it's possible to lose accounts
079//        if two people add new accounts right after each other from different wikis.
080public class XMLUserDatabase extends AbstractUserDatabase {
081
082    /** The jspwiki.properties property specifying the file system location of the user database. */
083    public static final String  PROP_USERDATABASE = "jspwiki.xmlUserDatabaseFile";
084    private static final String DEFAULT_USERDATABASE = "userdatabase.xml";
085    private static final String ATTRIBUTES_TAG    = "attributes";
086    private static final String OLD_HASHES_TAG    = "oldhashes";
087    private static final String CREATED           = "created";
088    private static final String EMAIL             = "email";
089    private static final String FULL_NAME         = "fullName";
090    private static final String LOGIN_NAME        = "loginName";
091    private static final String LAST_MODIFIED     = "lastModified";
092    private static final String LOCK_EXPIRY       = "lockExpiry";
093    private static final String PASSWORD          = "password";
094    private static final String UID               = "uid";
095    private static final String USER_TAG          = "user";
096    private static final String WIKI_NAME         = "wikiName";
097    private static final String DATE_FORMAT       = "yyyy.MM.dd 'at' HH:mm:ss:SSS z";
098    private Document            c_dom;
099    private File                c_file;
100    private int m_passwordReusedCount = -1;
101
102    /** {@inheritDoc} */
103    @Override
104    public synchronized void deleteByLoginName( final String loginName ) throws WikiSecurityException {
105        if( c_dom == null ) {
106            throw new WikiSecurityException( "FATAL: database does not exist" );
107        }
108
109        final NodeList users = c_dom.getDocumentElement().getElementsByTagName( USER_TAG );
110        for( int i = 0; i < users.getLength(); i++ ) {
111            final Element user = ( Element )users.item( i );
112            if( user.getAttribute( LOGIN_NAME ).equals( loginName ) ) {
113                c_dom.getDocumentElement().removeChild( user );
114
115                // Commit to disk
116                saveDOM();
117                return;
118            }
119        }
120        throw new NoSuchPrincipalException( "Not in database: " + loginName );
121    }

153    public UserProfile findBy( final String attr, final String value ) throws NoSuchPrincipalException {
154        final UserProfile profile = findByAttribute( attr, value );
155        if ( profile != null ) {
156            return profile;
157        }
158        throw new NoSuchPrincipalException( "Not in database: " + value );
159    }
160
161    /** {@inheritDoc} */
162    @Override
163    public Principal[] getWikiNames() throws WikiSecurityException {
164        if ( c_dom == null ) {
165            throw new IllegalStateException( "FATAL: database does not exist" );
166        }
167        final SortedSet< WikiPrincipal > principals = new TreeSet<>();
168        final NodeList users = c_dom.getElementsByTagName( USER_TAG );
169        for( int i = 0; i < users.getLength(); i++ ) {
170            final Element user = ( Element )users.item( i );
171            final String wikiName = user.getAttribute( WIKI_NAME );
172            if( StringUtils.isEmpty( wikiName ) ) {
173                LOG.warn( "Detected null or empty wiki name for {} in XMLUserDataBase. Check your user database.", user.getAttribute( LOGIN_NAME ) );
174            } else {
175                final WikiPrincipal principal = new WikiPrincipal( wikiName, WikiPrincipal.WIKI_NAME );
176                principals.add( principal );
177            }
178        }
179        return principals.toArray( new Principal[0] );
180    }
181
182    /** {@inheritDoc} */
183    @Override
184    public void initialize( final Engine engine, final Properties props ) throws NoRequiredPropertyException {
185        m_engine = engine;
186        final File defaultFile;
187        if( engine.getRootPath() == null ) {
188            LOG.warn( "Cannot identify JSPWiki root path" );
189            defaultFile = new File( "WEB-INF/" + DEFAULT_USERDATABASE ).getAbsoluteFile();
190        } else {
191            defaultFile = new File( engine.getRootPath() + "/WEB-INF/" + DEFAULT_USERDATABASE );
192        }
193
194        // Get database file location
195        final String file = TextUtil.getStringProperty( props, PROP_USERDATABASE, defaultFile.getAbsolutePath() );
196        if( file == null ) {
197            LOG.warn( "XML user database property " + PROP_USERDATABASE + " not found; trying " + defaultFile );
198            c_file = defaultFile;
199        } else {
200            c_file = new File( file );
201        }
202
203        LOG.info( "XML user database at " + c_file.getAbsolutePath() );
204        m_passwordReusedCount = TextUtil.getIntegerProperty( props, "jspwiki.credentials.reuseCount", -1);
205        File checkFile = new File(c_file.getParent(), c_file.getName() + ".check");
206        if (checkFile.exists()) {
207            
208            byte[] computedHash = null;
209            byte[] storedHash = null;
210            try (FileInputStream fis = new FileInputStream(c_file)) {
211                computedHash = DigestUtils.sha256(fis);
212                storedHash = FileUtils.readFileToByteArray(checkFile);
213            } catch (Exception ex) {
214                throw new RuntimeException("Failed to compute integrity check. ", ex);
215            } 
216            if (Arrays.equals(computedHash, storedHash)) {
217                LOG.info("XML user database hash check passed. no modifications detected.");
218            } else {
219                throw new RuntimeException("XML user database has been modified outside of JSP Wiki. Refusing start up. An administrator will need to restore the file from backup");
220            }
221
222        } else {
223            LOG.info("XML user database check file does not exist. This is normal if JSPWIki was just installed.");
224        }
225        
226        buildDOM();
227        sanitizeDOM();
228    }
229
230    private void buildDOM() {
231        // Read DOM
232        final DocumentBuilderFactory factory = DocumentBuilderFactory.newInstance();
233        factory.setValidating( false );
234        factory.setExpandEntityReferences( false );
235        factory.setIgnoringComments( true );
236        factory.setNamespaceAware( false );
237        factory.setAttribute( XMLConstants.ACCESS_EXTERNAL_DTD, "" );
238        factory.setAttribute( XMLConstants.ACCESS_EXTERNAL_SCHEMA, "" );
239        try {
240            c_dom = factory.newDocumentBuilder().parse( c_file );
241            LOG.debug( "Database successfully initialized" );
242            c_lastModified = c_file.lastModified();
243            c_lastCheck = System.currentTimeMillis();
244        } catch( final ParserConfigurationException e ) {
245            LOG.error( "Configuration error: {}", e.getMessage() );
246        } catch( final SAXException e ) {
247            LOG.error( "SAX error: {}", e.getMessage() );
248        } catch( final FileNotFoundException e ) {
249            LOG.info( "User database not found; creating from scratch..." );
250        } catch( final IOException e ) {
251            LOG.error( "IO error: {}", e.getMessage() );
252        } catch( final Exception e ) {
253            LOG.error( "Error initializing XML database from: {} {}", c_file.getAbsolutePath(), e.getMessage() );
254        }
255        if ( c_dom == null ) {
256            try {
257                //  Create the DOM from scratch
258                c_dom = factory.newDocumentBuilder().newDocument();
259                c_dom.appendChild( c_dom.createElement( "users" ) );
260            } catch( final ParserConfigurationException e ) {
261                LOG.fatal( "Could not create in-memory DOM" );
262            }
263        }
264    }
265
266    private void saveDOM() throws WikiSecurityException {
267        if( c_dom == null ) {
268            throw new IllegalStateException( "FATAL: database does not exist" );
269        }
270
271        final File newFile = new File( c_file.getAbsolutePath() + ".new" );
272        try( final BufferedWriter io = new BufferedWriter( new OutputStreamWriter( Files.newOutputStream( newFile.toPath() ), StandardCharsets.UTF_8 ) ) ) {
273
274            // Write the file header and document root
275            io.write( "<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?>\n" );
276            io.write( "<users>\n" );
277
278            // Write each profile as a <user> node
279            final Element root = c_dom.getDocumentElement();
280            final NodeList nodes = root.getElementsByTagName( USER_TAG );
281            for( int i = 0; i < nodes.getLength(); i++ ) {
282                final Element user = ( Element )nodes.item( i );
283                io.write( "    <" + USER_TAG + " " );
284                io.write( UID );
285                io.write( "=\"" + StringEscapeUtils.escapeXml11( user.getAttribute( UID ) ) + "\" " );
286                io.write( LOGIN_NAME );
287                io.write( "=\"" + StringEscapeUtils.escapeXml11( user.getAttribute( LOGIN_NAME ) ) + "\" " );
288                io.write( WIKI_NAME );
289                io.write( "=\"" + StringEscapeUtils.escapeXml11( user.getAttribute( WIKI_NAME ) ) + "\" " );
290                io.write( FULL_NAME );
291                io.write( "=\"" + StringEscapeUtils.escapeXml11( user.getAttribute( FULL_NAME ) ) + "\" " );
292                io.write( EMAIL );
293                io.write( "=\"" + StringEscapeUtils.escapeXml11( user.getAttribute( EMAIL ) ) + "\" " );
294                io.write( PASSWORD );
295                io.write( "=\"" + StringEscapeUtils.escapeXml11( user.getAttribute( PASSWORD ) ) + "\" " );
296                io.write( CREATED );
297                io.write( "=\"" + StringEscapeUtils.escapeXml11( user.getAttribute( CREATED ) ) + "\" " );
298                io.write( LAST_MODIFIED );
299                io.write( "=\"" + StringEscapeUtils.escapeXml11( user.getAttribute( LAST_MODIFIED ) ) + "\" " );
300                io.write( LOCK_EXPIRY );
301                io.write( "=\"" + StringEscapeUtils.escapeXml11( user.getAttribute( LOCK_EXPIRY ) ) + "\" " );
302                io.write( OLD_HASHES_TAG );
303                io.write( "=\"" + StringEscapeUtils.escapeXml11( user.getAttribute( OLD_HASHES_TAG ) ) + "\" " );
304                io.write( ">" );
305                final NodeList attributes = user.getElementsByTagName( ATTRIBUTES_TAG );
306                for( int j = 0; j < attributes.getLength(); j++ ) {
307                    final Element attribute = ( Element )attributes.item( j );
308                    final String value = extractText( attribute );
309                    io.write( "\n        <" + ATTRIBUTES_TAG + ">" );
310                    io.write( value );
311                    io.write( "</" + ATTRIBUTES_TAG + ">" );
312                }
313                io.write( "\n    </" + USER_TAG + ">\n" );
314            }
315            io.write( "</users>" );
316        } catch( final IOException e ) {
317            throw new WikiSecurityException( e.getLocalizedMessage(), e );
318        }
319
320        // Copy new file over old version
321        final File backup = new File( c_file.getAbsolutePath() + ".old" );
322        if( backup.exists() ) {
323            if( !backup.delete() ) {
324                LOG.error( "Could not delete old user database backup: " + backup );
325            }
326        }
327        if( !c_file.renameTo( backup ) ) {
328            LOG.error( "Could not create user database backup: " + backup );
329        }
330        if( !newFile.renameTo( c_file ) ) {
331            LOG.error( "Could not save database: " + backup + " restoring backup." );
332            if( !backup.renameTo( c_file ) ) {
333                LOG.error( "Restore failed. Check the file permissions." );
334            }
335            LOG.error( "Could not save database: " + c_file + ". Check the file permissions" );
336        }
337        
338        try (FileInputStream fis = new FileInputStream(c_file)) {
339            byte[] hash = DigestUtils.sha256(fis);
340            File checkFile = new File(c_file.getParent(), c_file.getName() + ".check");
341            FileUtils.writeByteArrayToFile(checkFile, hash);
342        } catch (Exception ex) {
343            LOG.warn("Failed to recompute and/or save the check file", ex);
344        }
345    }
346
347    private long c_lastCheck;
348    private long c_lastModified;
349
350    private void checkForRefresh() {
351        final long time = System.currentTimeMillis();
352        if( time - c_lastCheck > 60 * 1000L ) {
353            final long lastModified = c_file.lastModified();
354
355            if( lastModified > c_lastModified ) {
356                buildDOM();
357            }
358        }
359    }
360
361    /**
362     * {@inheritDoc}
363     *
364     * @see org.apache.wiki.auth.user.UserDatabase#rename(String, String)
365     */
366    @Override
367    public synchronized void rename( final String loginName, final String newName) throws DuplicateUserException, WikiSecurityException {
368        if( c_dom == null ) {
369            LOG.fatal( "Could not rename profile '" + loginName + "'; database does not exist" );
370            throw new IllegalStateException( "FATAL: database does not exist" );
371        }
372        checkForRefresh();
373
374        // Get the existing user; if not found, throws NoSuchPrincipalException
375        final UserProfile profile = findByLoginName( loginName );
376
377        // Get user with the proposed name; if found, it's a collision
378        try {
379            final UserProfile otherProfile = findByLoginName( newName );
380            if( otherProfile != null ) {
381                throw new DuplicateUserException( "security.error.cannot.rename", newName );
382            }
383        } catch( final NoSuchPrincipalException e ) {
384            LOG.debug(e.getMessage(), e);
385            // Good! That means it's safe to save using the new name
386        }
387
388        // Find the user with the old login id attribute, and change it
389        final NodeList users = c_dom.getElementsByTagName( USER_TAG );
390        for( int i = 0; i < users.getLength(); i++ ) {
391            final Element user = ( Element )users.item( i );
392            if( user.getAttribute( LOGIN_NAME ).equals( loginName ) ) {
393                final DateFormat c_format = new SimpleDateFormat( DATE_FORMAT );
394                final Date modDate = new Date( System.currentTimeMillis() );
395                setAttribute( user, LOGIN_NAME, newName );
396                setAttribute( user, LAST_MODIFIED, c_format.format( modDate ) );
397                profile.setLoginName( newName );
398                profile.setLastModified( modDate );
399                break;
400            }
401        }
402
403        // Commit to disk
404        saveDOM();
405    }
406
407    /** {@inheritDoc} */
408    @Override
409    public synchronized void save( final UserProfile profile ) throws WikiSecurityException {
410        if ( c_dom == null ) {
411            LOG.fatal( "Could not save profile " + profile + " database does not exist" );
412            throw new IllegalStateException( "FATAL: database does not exist" );
413        }
414
415        checkForRefresh();
416
417        final DateFormat c_format = new SimpleDateFormat( DATE_FORMAT );
418        final String index = profile.getLoginName();
419        final NodeList users = c_dom.getElementsByTagName( USER_TAG );
420        Element user = IntStream.range(0, users.getLength()).mapToObj(i -> (Element) users.item(i)).filter(currentUser -> currentUser.getAttribute(LOGIN_NAME).equals(index)).findFirst().orElse(null);
421
422        boolean isNew = false;
423
424        final Date modDate = new Date( System.currentTimeMillis() );
425        if( user == null ) {
426            // Create new user node
427            profile.setCreated( modDate );
428            LOG.info( "Creating new user " + index );
429            user = c_dom.createElement( USER_TAG );
430            c_dom.getDocumentElement().appendChild( user );
431            setAttribute( user, CREATED, c_format.format( profile.getCreated() ) );
432            isNew = true;
433        } else {
434            // To update existing user node, delete old attributes first...
435            final NodeList attributes = user.getElementsByTagName( ATTRIBUTES_TAG );
436            for( int i = 0; i < attributes.getLength(); i++ ) {
437                user.removeChild( attributes.item( i ) );
438            }
439        }
440
441        setAttribute( user, UID, profile.getUid() );
442        setAttribute( user, LAST_MODIFIED, c_format.format( modDate ) );
443        setAttribute( user, LOGIN_NAME, profile.getLoginName() );
444        setAttribute( user, FULL_NAME, profile.getFullname() );
445        setAttribute( user, WIKI_NAME, profile.getWikiName() );
446        setAttribute( user, EMAIL, profile.getEmail() );
447        final Date lockExpiry = profile.getLockExpiry();
448        setAttribute( user, LOCK_EXPIRY, lockExpiry == null ? "" : c_format.format( lockExpiry ) );
449
450        // Hash and save the new password if it's different from old one
451        final String newPassword = profile.getPassword();
452        if( newPassword != null && !newPassword.equals( "" ) ) {
453            final String oldPassword = user.getAttribute( PASSWORD );
454            if( !oldPassword.equals( newPassword ) ) {
455                String newhash = getHash( newPassword );
456                setAttribute( user, PASSWORD, newhash );
457            
458                profile.getPreviousHashedCredentials().add(newhash);
459                while (!profile.getPreviousHashedCredentials().isEmpty() && 
460                        profile.getPreviousHashedCredentials().size() > m_passwordReusedCount) {
461                    profile.getPreviousHashedCredentials().remove(0);
462                }
463
464            }
465        }
466
467        // Save the attributes as Base64 string
468        if(!profile.getAttributes().isEmpty()) {
469            try {
470                final String encodedAttributes = Serializer.serializeToBase64( profile.getAttributes() );
471                final Element attributes = c_dom.createElement( ATTRIBUTES_TAG );
472                user.appendChild( attributes );
473                final Text value = c_dom.createTextNode( encodedAttributes );
474                attributes.appendChild( value );
475            } catch( final IOException e ) {
476                throw new WikiSecurityException( "Could not save user profile attribute. Reason: " + e.getMessage(), e );
477            }
478        }
479        if (!profile.getPreviousHashedCredentials().isEmpty()) {
480            setAttribute( user, OLD_HASHES_TAG, StringUtils.join(profile.getPreviousHashedCredentials(), "|"));
481        }
482
483        // Set the profile timestamps
484        if( isNew ) {
485            profile.setCreated( modDate );
486        }
487        profile.setLastModified( modDate );
488
489        // Commit to disk
490        saveDOM();
491    }
492
493    /**
494     * Private method that returns the first {@link UserProfile}matching a &lt;user&gt; element's supplied attribute. This method will also
495     * set the UID if it has not yet been set.
496     *
497     * @param matchAttribute matching attribute
498     * @param index value to match
499     * @return the profile, or <code>null</code> if not found
500     */
501    private UserProfile findByAttribute( final String matchAttribute, String index ) {
502        if ( c_dom == null ) {
503            throw new IllegalStateException( "FATAL: database does not exist" );
504        }
505
506        checkForRefresh();
507        final NodeList users = c_dom.getElementsByTagName( USER_TAG );
508        if( users == null ) {
509            return null;
510        }
511
512        // check if we have to do a case-insensitive compare
513        final boolean caseSensitiveCompare = !matchAttribute.equals( EMAIL );
514
515        for( int i = 0; i < users.getLength(); i++ ) {
516            final Element user = (Element) users.item( i );
517            String userAttribute = user.getAttribute( matchAttribute );
518            if( !caseSensitiveCompare ) {
519                userAttribute = StringUtils.lowerCase(userAttribute);
520                index = StringUtils.lowerCase(index);
521            }
522            if( userAttribute.equals( index ) ) {
523                final UserProfile profile = newProfile();
524
525                // Parse basic attributes
526                profile.setUid( user.getAttribute( UID ) );
527                if( profile.getUid() == null || profile.getUid().isEmpty() ) {
528                    profile.setUid( generateUid( this ) );
529                }
530                profile.setLoginName( user.getAttribute( LOGIN_NAME ) );
531                profile.setFullname( user.getAttribute( FULL_NAME ) );
532                profile.setPassword( user.getAttribute( PASSWORD ) );
533                profile.setEmail( user.getAttribute( EMAIL ) );
534
535                // Get created/modified timestamps
536                final String created = user.getAttribute( CREATED );
537                final String modified = user.getAttribute( LAST_MODIFIED );
538                profile.setCreated( parseDate( profile, created ) );
539                profile.setLastModified( parseDate( profile, modified ) );
540
541                // Is the profile locked?
542                final String lockExpiry = user.getAttribute( LOCK_EXPIRY );
543                if( StringUtils.isEmpty( lockExpiry ) || lockExpiry.isEmpty() ) {
544                    profile.setLockExpiry( null );
545                } else {
546                    profile.setLockExpiry( new Date( Long.parseLong( lockExpiry ) ) );
547                }
548                final String oldHahes = user.getAttribute(OLD_HASHES_TAG);
549                if (oldHahes != null && oldHahes.length() > 0) {
550                    String[] parts = oldHahes.split("\\|");
551                    for (String s : parts) {
552                        profile.getPreviousHashedCredentials().add(s);
553                    }
554                }
555
556                // Extract all the user's attributes (should only be one attributes tag, but you never know!)
557                final NodeList attributes = user.getElementsByTagName( ATTRIBUTES_TAG );
558                for( int j = 0; j < attributes.getLength(); j++ ) {
559                    final Element attribute = ( Element )attributes.item( j );
560                    final String serializedMap = extractText( attribute );
561                    try {
562                        final Map< String, ? extends Serializable > map = Serializer.deserializeFromBase64( serializedMap );
563                        profile.getAttributes().putAll( map );
564                    } catch( final IOException e ) {
565                        LOG.error( "Could not parse user profile attributes!", e );
566                    }
567                }
568
569                return profile;
570            }
571        }
572        return null;
573    }
574
575    /**
576     * Extracts all the text nodes that are immediate children of an Element.
577     *
578     * @param element the base element
579     * @return the text nodes that are immediate children of the base element, concatenated together
580     */
581    private String extractText( final Element element ) {
582        String text = "";
583        if( element.getChildNodes().getLength() > 0 ) {
584            final NodeList children = element.getChildNodes();
585            text = IntStream.range(0, children.getLength()).mapToObj(children::item).filter(child -> child.getNodeType() == Node.TEXT_NODE).map(child -> ((Text) child).getData()).collect(Collectors.joining());
586        }
587        return text;
588    }
589
590    /**
591     *  Tries to parse a date using the default format - then, for backwards compatibility reasons, tries the platform default.
592     *
593     *  @param profile profile associated to the date.
594     *  @param date date to be parsed.
595     *  @return A parsed date, or null, if both parse attempts fail.
596     */
597    private Date parseDate( final UserProfile profile, final String date ) {
598        try {
599            final DateFormat c_format = new SimpleDateFormat( DATE_FORMAT );
600            return c_format.parse( date );
601        } catch( final ParseException e ) {
602            try {
603                return DateFormat.getDateTimeInstance().parse( date );
604            } catch( final ParseException e2 ) {
605                LOG.warn( "Could not parse 'created' or 'lastModified' attribute for profile '" + profile.getLoginName() + "'." +
606                          " It may have been tampered with.", e2 );
607            }
608        }
609        return null;
610    }
611
612    /**
613     * After loading the DOM, this method sanity-checks the dates in the DOM and makes sure they are formatted properly. This is sort-of
614     * hacky, but it should work.
615     */
616    private void sanitizeDOM() {
617        if( c_dom == null ) {
618            throw new IllegalStateException( "FATAL: database does not exist" );
619        }
620
621        final NodeList users = c_dom.getElementsByTagName( USER_TAG );
622        for( int i = 0; i < users.getLength(); i++ ) {
623            final Element user = ( Element )users.item( i );
624
625            // Sanitize UID (and generate a new one if one does not exist)
626            String uid = user.getAttribute( UID ).trim();
627            if( StringUtils.isEmpty( uid ) || "-1".equals( uid ) ) {
628                uid = String.valueOf( generateUid( this ) );
629                user.setAttribute( UID, uid );
630            }
631
632            // Sanitize dates
633            final String loginName = user.getAttribute( LOGIN_NAME );
634            String created = user.getAttribute( CREATED );
635            String modified = user.getAttribute( LAST_MODIFIED );
636            final DateFormat c_format = new SimpleDateFormat( DATE_FORMAT );
637            try {
638                created = c_format.format( c_format.parse( created ) );
639                modified = c_format.format( c_format.parse( modified ) );
640                user.setAttribute( CREATED, created );
641                user.setAttribute( LAST_MODIFIED, modified );
642            } catch( final ParseException e ) {
643                try {
644                    created = c_format.format( DateFormat.getDateTimeInstance().parse( created ) );
645                    modified = c_format.format( DateFormat.getDateTimeInstance().parse( modified ) );
646                    user.setAttribute( CREATED, created );
647                    user.setAttribute( LAST_MODIFIED, modified );
648                } catch( final ParseException e2 ) {
649                    LOG.warn( "Could not parse 'created' or 'lastModified' attribute for profile '" + loginName + "'."
650                            + " It may have been tampered with." );
651                }
652            }
653        }
654    }

656    /**
657     * Private method that sets an attribute value for a supplied DOM element.
658     *
659     * @param element the element whose attribute is to be set
660     * @param attribute the name of the attribute to set
661     * @param value the desired attribute value
662     */
663    private void setAttribute( final Element element, final String attribute, final String value ) {
664        if( value != null ) {
665            element.setAttribute( attribute, value );
666        }
667    }
